acceptance: This frozen companion binds only the exact six materialized CBM source and test paths from the reviewed PRE1A packet; it creates no claim, lease, writer, provider, network, stage, commit, push, deploy, live or USI registration authority.
A later durable critical-Sol claim is limited to the exact six frozen CBM source and test paths and starts with all fifteen named tests before source edits.

The internal structural provider exposes start, exactly-once interrupt acknowledgement, terminate-to-kill escalation, one bounded monotonic cleanup wait, terminal process readback and task join before any result or query-facing error can publish.
One process owns at most one active structural execution handle; saturation, expired deadlines, foreign identities and a closed or quarantined process fail before writing to child stdin.

After interrupt, timeout, deadline expiry or close, response bytes are discarded before JSON parsing, mapping, counters or result construction; only an uninterrupted joined completion may be consumed once.
The existing synchronous StructuralQueryProvider remains fixture-only and explicitly non-registerable; no query-only product bypass, public or direct CBM tool, or USI registration is added.
Client close interrupts and joins the active structural handle before shutdown, and repeated completion, cancel and timeout races leave zero handles, tasks, streams and child processes.
Focused, dependency, static and central tiers plus fresh hostile QA and fresh Root/Sol deep review pass on one frozen future six-blob candidate.
forbidden: Any implementation before Root registers and reads back a separate durable claim binding this exact companion, source packet, authority, baselines, tests and correction class.
Any seventh writer path, router, Guidance, roadmap, Evidence, runtime-context, USI planner, lexical, SQLite, tool catalog, provider registration, UI, migration or store edit.
Any public or direct exposure of index_repository, query_graph, search_graph, search_code, query_structural or another upstream CBM method or MCP tool.
Any real executable, productive provider, repository indexing, source read, filesystem mutation, network call, listener, install, update, watcher, hook, config, private-data or live action.

A query-only product provider, to_thread or executor cancellation, daemon or abandoned task, result-only discard without process interruption, terminate or kill without wait, unbounded join or return before join.

Caller-cleared or caller-extended cancellation, mutable or coercible execution identity, wall-clock deadline, second active structural handle, callback under handle lock or consumption before joined completion.
Raw request, query, response, process output, path, PID, exception or provider detail in repr, error, snapshot, log or terminal readback.
hostile_matrix: Start races interruption before registration, during stdin drain and during stdout read; the exact immutable execution key is registered before child I/O and only one active handle is admitted.

First interrupt records one bounded reason and acknowledges only after terminate is attempted or terminality is known; duplicate and concurrent interrupts return the same acknowledgement and signal at most once.
Completion racing interrupt, timeout or close publishes at most once and only from uninterrupted COMPLETED_JOINED; every interrupted terminal state remains content-free.

Terminate, kill, process wait and exchange-task join consume one shared monotonic cleanup budget; kill without confirmed wait, a renewed budget or return before join is rejected and quarantines the process.

Bytes, EOF and exceptions arriving after interrupt, timeout, deadline expiry or close are discarded before JSON parsing, identity validation, mapping, counters, fallback evidence or result construction.
Expired or caller-extended deadlines, foreign or mutable identities, a second handle, stopped process and quarantined process fail before child stdin and cannot expose raw detail.

Client close, provider timeout and cancellation idempotently interrupt and join the same handle; callbacks execute outside the handle lock and repeated release leaves zero handles, tasks, streams and children.
Client response ID and canonical JSON-RPC envelope validation occur only after terminal join; malformed or mismatched responses never become structural results.
The legacy synchronous StructuralQueryProvider remains fixture-only with product_registerable false, while direct CBM methods and public tool registration remain rejected.
Any baseline, authority, source-packet, test-node, claim, lease, path or correction-class drift stops future registration before a writer starts.
stop_rule: Stop before future registration or writer dispatch on authority, source-packet, baseline, path, overlap, command, named-node, claim or lease drift. Stop implementation on a seventh path, synchronous product bypass, second active handle, missing interrupt acknowledgement, duplicate signal, kill without wait, return before join, late payload parsing or publication, unbounded cleanup, raw-data leak, USI or tool registration, provider, network or live effect. After one same-class correction, release blocked and require fresh Root/Sol architecture.
threat_model: The accepted CBM process can terminate and wait after a request timeout, but the accepted structural provider is a synchronous transport call with only post-return timeout metadata and no execution handle. Result-delivery cancellation can therefore leave the child request running, parse late bytes, or expose a query-only provider that the parent USI planner cannot interrupt or join. PRE1A closes only the internal CBM process and provider lifecycle; PRE1B must separately bind authoritative UIR context before parent USI registration.

verification_tiers.central: Integration Spine, Round6 and Guidance validators after durable registration and again after candidate freeze, each bound to one unchanged authority tuple.
verification_tiers.dependency: The three complete claimed test modules plus CBM projection, code-intelligence retrieval, USI query, query-knowledge-tool and CBM vendor-lock suites, followed by py_compile and exact six-path diff-check.
verification_tiers.focused: All fifteen exact tests-first nodes must collect RED only for absent lifecycle behavior, then pass with the three complete claimed test modules under a claim-scoped basetemp.
verification_tiers.independent_qa: Fresh hostile process-race and resource-lifecycle QA against one frozen six-blob candidate, including interrupt, timeout, close, late-byte and completion races.
verification_tiers.sol_review: Fresh Root/Sol deep review of exact ownership, shared-budget terminate-to-kill wait and join, late suppression, no synchronous bypass, no seventh path and zero-resource terminal states.
